questions.question: Who has achieved the 50+ runs and 4+ wickets in a match double more times, Marizanne Kapp or Lizelle Lee?
questions.explanation: Marizanne Kapp: 1 times. Lizelle Lee: 4 times.

questions.question: Who topped the runs charts in the 17/18 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade led with 207 runs, a joint record shared with Stacey Lackay.

questions.question: What is South Africa Women's best-ever finish at a Cricket World Cup, achieved for the first time in 2025?
questions.explanation: South Africa reached their first-ever Women's World Cup final in 2025, finishing runners-up to India.
